method: Fresh network bare depth2 clone, no alternates. Explicitly fetched every needed blob, then with lazy fetch disabled read complete remote and local bytes and compared modes/blobs/sizes/SHA256. Partial clone or matching blob alone was never credited.
not_archival_backup: This verifies frozen artifact payload and input binding only. It is not a full Git object backup for future deletion of every historical source branch.
later_publication_rule: A successor may publish this proof. It does not revise frozen reviewed content, invent future self hashes or require recursive receipts.

tooling_attempt_history.cause: git ls-tree -rl on partial clone requests size of unrelated baseline blobs, triggering unwanted extra lazy fetch. Target916 blob fetch had completed.
tooling_attempt_history.correction: Reuse this fresh no-alternates bare object store, enumerate tree modes/OIDs only with -r and disable lazy fetch, then read every target complete byte and actual blob header size.
